s01.longHint: Checking the connection to the server

toast.slotFreed: Your opponent didn’t come back - the seat is free again
toast.oppLeft: {{opp}} left the lobby - the seat is free again
toast.soon: Coming in one of the next updates
toast.connection: No connection to the server - try again

resume.title: You have a game in progress

s03.heroText: Send a link to any chat - whoever opens it first is your opponent
s03.emptyTitle: Your matches will show up here
s03.emptyText: Play your first duel - a win earns the “First Blood” achievement

s05.title: Waiting for opponent
s05.sub: Send the invite to any chat
s05.shareText: Up for a 1v1 quiz? Whoever opens the link first is my opponent

oppOffline.title: {{opp}} went missing
oppOffline.sub: Let’s wait - they may come back

consent.title: {{opp}} challenges you
consent.text: Accept the documents before your first game. You can’t play without this
consent.declined: You can’t play without accepting the documents

taken.title: Game already taken
taken.text: Another player has already joined this duel

notFound.title: Game not found
notFound.text: The link is wrong or the game was deleted

expired.title: Invite expired
expired.text: The lobby waits 15 minutes for an opponent. Ask for a new link or create your own duel

cancelled.title: Game cancelled
cancelled.text: The host cancelled the duel before it started

finished.title: Game over
finished.text: This duel has already been played. Only its players can see the results

busy.title: You have a game in progress
busy.text: Finish your current duel first - you can’t play two games at once

stub.title: The duel has started!
stub.text: Question {{n}} of 10 is already running on the server. The question and reveal screens arrive in the next stage
stub.finishedText: The results screen arrives in one of the next stages
stub.noAnswersText: Nobody answered a single question, so the game was unrated

outside.title: Open in Telegram
outside.text: Quiz Duel runs inside Telegram: that's how we know who's playing and keep your rating.

error.title: The server isn't responding
error.text: Check your connection and try again. If a game was in progress, it's saved on the server.

session.title: Open again
session.text: Your sign-in data has expired or failed the check. Close the app and open it again from the bot.

otherDevice.title: Game open on another device
otherDevice.text: The game continues there. You can move it to this device

s02.chat: Quiz battle? Lose and you owe me a coffee

slides.title: Challenge a friend
slides.text: Send a link to any chat - whoever opens it first is your opponent

slides.title: Answer faster
slides.text: 10 questions, 15 seconds each. The faster the right answer, the more points

slides.title: Climb the leaderboard
slides.text: Win, collect achievements and break into the top 100
